parameters.content:
ZKTrustLLM-Agents L4 — Full Stage A-F + FF Master Orchestration

Purpose:
This master n8n page gives one supervisor-facing workflow diagram for the full experimental pipeline.

It combines:
Stage A: experiment initialisation and claim boundary
Stage B: repeatability evidence
Stage C: profile-pilot evidence
Stage D: real-variant matrix evidence
Stage E: single-agent multi-model baseline
Stage F: multi-agent scenarios
Stage F/F: four-model inter-agent communication

Main AI/tool agents:
1. GPT-5.5 Planner
2. Claude Fable 5 Evidence Critic
3. DeepSeek Recovery Agent
4. Mistral Verifier/Arbiter

Claim boundary:
This workflow supports local evidence-grounded orchestration and inter-agent evaluation. It does not claim production O-RAN deployment validation, packet-capture benchmarking, public-chain benchmarking, full media-plane QoE validation, or a 240-run six-variant ablation.

assignments.name: claim_boundary
assignments.value: Local workflow repeatability, local evidence-grounded orchestration, multi-model baseline evaluation, multi-agent evaluation, and four-model inter-agent communication. Not production O-RAN deployment validation, packet-capture benchmarking, public-chain benchmarking, full media-plane QoE validation, or a 240-run six-variant ablation.

assignments.name: stage_d_real_matrix
assignments.value: Stage D-real: 120 local real-variant matrix runs.

assignments.name: stage_e_single_agent_baseline
assignments.value: Stage E: single-agent multi-model baseline using Claude, DeepSeek, and Mistral.

assignments.name: stage_f_multi_agent_cases
assignments.value: Stage F: multi-agent scenarios including task decomposition, collaboration, failure recovery, verification, and disagreement resolution.

assignments.value: GPT-5.5 Planner Agent: decomposes the task and creates the initial structured plan.

assignments.name: claude_critic
assignments.value: Claude Fable 5 Evidence Critic: checks the plan against frozen evidence and claim boundaries.

assignments.name: deepseek_recovery
assignments.value: DeepSeek Recovery Agent: repairs malformed JSON, missing fields, or unsafe claim wording.

assignments.name: mistral_arbiter
assignments.value: Mistral Verifier/Arbiter: resolves disagreement and produces the final evidence-grounded result.
